title: Binary vector associated to a finite set
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every finite set $S\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the inverse of the binary-cube-to-finite-set equivalence sends $S$ to the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $1$ when $i\in S$ and $0$ otherwise.
